name: Jonah
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: He restored the coast of Israel according to the word spoken by Jonah the son of Amittai, for the Most High saw the bitter affliction of Israel and would not blot out their name.

note.label: 2 Kings 14: Amaziah, the Imperfect Heart, and Jeroboam II

points: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord, went down to Joppa, found a ship going to Tarshish, paid the fare thereof, and went down into it.

note.label: Jonah 1: Fleeing From the Presence of the Lord

points: They cried unto the Lord, Lay not upon us innocent blood; then they took up Jonah and cast him into the sea, and the sea ceased from her raging, and the men feared the Lord exceedingly.
Now the Lord had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah; and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

note.label: Jonah 1: Fleeing From the Presence of the Lord

points: The Lord spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.

note.label: Jonah 2: The Prayer Out of the Fish's Belly

points: The word of the Lord came unto Jonah the second time, saying, Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.

note.label: Jonah 3: The Preaching That Turned Nineveh

points: Jonah arose and went unto Nineveh according to the word of the Lord; and he cried, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.

note.label: Jonah 3: The Preaching That Turned Nineveh

points: It displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.

note.label: Jonah 4: The Gourd and the Question at the End

points: Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.

note.label: Jonah 4: The Gourd and the Question at the End

points: The scribes and Pharisees ask for a sign, and no sign is given but the sign of the prophet Jonas: three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

note.label: Matthew 12: Lord of the Sabbath and the Blasphemy Against the Holy Ghost

points: This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

note.label: Luke 11: How to Pray, the Strong Man, and the Woes

points: The men of Nineveh repented at the preaching of Jonas, and a greater than Jonas is here. Men came a long way for less than what these would not cross the room for.

note.label: Luke 11: How to Pray, the Strong Man, and the Woes

cases.name: Nineveh under Jonah
cases.charge: Wickedness come up before the Lord; and turning every one from his evil way, and from the violence that was in their hands
cases.preview: Jonah was sent to cry against Nineveh, the great city of Assyria, because its wickedness had come up before the Lord;

cases.name: Jonah
cases.charge: Rising up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord instead of going to Nineveh to cry against it
cases.preview: The word of the Lord sent Jonah the son of Amittai to cry against Nineveh, and he rose up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the Lord (Jonah 1:1-3).
